notes: Optional `billable` field was missing from the create schema; fixed in canonical source (commit a4e72bb).
Clockify rejects DELETE of an ACTIVE task: it must be marked status DONE first (GET-then-PUT overlay `status: "DONE"`, then DELETE).
Bare-array pagination via `page`/`page-size`; `Last-Page` response header is authoritative.
Proven replacement risk: PUT replaces; resend all fields to avoid data loss.
Rate `amount` is an integer in minor units (cents); no currency scaling applied by the SDK.
GET on a rate path returns 405; read the current rate from the task/project document.
UNRESOLVED: PUT omission behavior unproven; treat as potential replacement.
